'''Svivreni''' was a language spoken by the [[Svivreni]] species from [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]].

[[Human/Legends|Humans]] could not reproduce the vocal range of this language, and not all the Svivreni learned [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].
